rationale: C10 is an unmistakable reusable template for the child: it quotes the same subsection defining “opiate,” recites the same Treasury notice-and-hearing finding, and uses virtually the same operative proclamation, with Isoamidone and its chemical description replaced by Keto-bemidone and its description. C05 and C13 share weaker agency-recommendation or agency-finding followed by presidential proclamation machinery, but not the child’s distinctive language and exact sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: (f) OPIATE. The word "opiate" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an ... liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: (f) Opiate. The word "opiate" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces the same statutory quotation and presidential-proclamation mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found the drug Keto-bemidone ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found the drug Isoamidone ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The factual recital is nearly verbatim, substituting the new drug and chemical name.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found the drug Keto-bemidone ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found the drug Isoamidone ... to have an addition-forming and addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision follows the same wording and performs the identical legal function for a different drug.
